title: Miso lentil and greens soup
summary: Miso lentil and greens soup is a japanese dinner built around dried green lentils and rice miso paste, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Miso lentil and greens soup. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add dried green lentils and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and rice miso paste.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until kale is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Miso lentil and greens soup before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Miso lentil and greens soup.
